NULL = tskit.NULL


def covered_spans(ts, windows):
    """Non-missing span per window: span covered by >=1 edge."""
    out = np.zeros(len(windows) - 1)
    for t in ts.trees():
        if t.num_edges == 0:
            continue
        l, r = t.interval
        for w in range(len(out)):
            ov = min(r, windows[w + 1]) - max(l, windows[w])
            if ov > 0:
                out[w] += ov
    return out


def brute_counts(ts, sample_sets, indexes, windows, node_bin_map, num_bins,
                 span_normalise, pair_normalise):
    out = np.zeros((len(windows) - 1, len(indexes), num_bins))
    cov = covered_spans(ts, windows)
    totals = []
    for (i, j) in indexes:
        n = len(sample_sets[i]) * len(sample_sets[j])
        if i == j:
            n -= len(sample_sets[i])
            n /= 2
        totals.append(n)
    for t in ts.trees():
        l, r = t.interval
        for w in range(out.shape[0]):
            ov = min(r, windows[w + 1]) - max(l, windows[w])
            if ov <= 0:
                continue
            for si, (i, j) in enumerate(indexes):
                for x in sample_sets[i]:
                    for y in sample_sets[j]:
                        if i == j and y <= x:
                            continue
                        m = t.mrca(x, y)
                        if m == NULL:
                            continue
                        b = node_bin_map[m]
                        if b != NULL:
                            out[w, si, b] += ov
    for w in range(out.shape[0]):
        for si in range(len(indexes)):
            den = 1.0
            if span_normalise:
                den *= cov[w] if cov[w] > 0 else (windows[w + 1] - windows[w])
            if pair_normalise:
                den *= totals[si]
            out[w, si] /= den
    return out


def brute_rates(ts, sample_sets, indexes, windows, time_windows):
    """rates from per-pair-either-tree coalescence times via the documented
    ecdf formulas, normalising by non-missing span."""
    ntw = len(time_windows) - 1
    out = np.full((len(windows) - 1, len(indexes), ntw), np.nan)
    cov = covered_spans(ts, windows)
    totals = []
    for (i, j) in indexes:
        n = len(sample_sets[i]) * len(sample_sets[j])
        if i == j:
            n -= len(sample_sets[i])
            n /= 2
        totals.append(n)
    for w in range(out.shape[0]):
        wl, wr = windows[w], windows[w + 1]
        cs = cov[w] if cov[w] > 0 else (wr - wl)
        for si, (i, j) in enumerate(indexes):
            weight = np.zeros(ntw)   # ecdf mass per time window
            tsum = np.zeros(ntw)     # sum of times per time window

def insert_gaps(ts, gaps):
    """Return a ts with empty intervals inserted at existing breakpoints.

                                + sum(gap_at.values()))
    new.populations.metadata_schema = tables.populations.metadata_schema
    for row in tables.populations:

    for row in tables.individuals:

    return new.tree_sequence()
